## Analysis Steps
1. Trim adapters (Cutadapt) and low-quality reads
2. Align filtered reads to the reference genome (BWA)
3. Mark duplicates (Picard) and filter out low-quality alignments (SAMtools)
4. Combine alignments within groups (e.g., replicates)
5. Peak calling (MACS2) and visualize peaks (deepTools)
6. Annotate peaks (ChIPseeker) and perform motif analysis (HOMER)
7. Differential binding analysis (DiffBind) and pathway enrichment analysis (clusterProfiler)
